# The Medley Group
> Relationship-driven commercial loan brokerage firm arranging $10M–$400M+ in debt and equity financing for large-scale commercial real estate.

## About
The Medley Group is a family-owned, faith-based commercial loan brokerage with 100+ years of combined expertise, 50+ lending partners, and a 95% client success rate. Based in Las Vegas, Nevada, we arrange financing for projects nationwide — in all 50 states and the Caribbean. We serve developers, operators, and business owners across construction, hospitality, hotels, stadiums, healthcare, casinos, multifamily, and large commercial real estate.

## Services
- Commercial Loan Consultation
- Loan Structuring & Packaging
- Financial Analysis & Strategy
Financing types: construction, bridge, mezzanine, private/non-bank debt, equity placement, acquisition, refinance, and recapitalization.
